title: CLAUDE.md (vault-root) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for the vault-root CLAUDE.md body-structure contract. The k8s ValidatingAdmissionPolicy paramKind for the only mandatory vault-root file.

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh (size cap + section presence) + hooks/post-write-verify.sh (Mustache substitution validation post-install)
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: R-37 atomic lockstep — runtime artifact + template updated in one commit

size_limits.rationale: Hard cap — the vault-root CLAUDE.md stays a lean orientation file.

prohibited_rationale: Hooks read governance bundles from disk directly; CLAUDE.md @import is for Claude's reading context only, not hook function. @import of foundation-master / overlay-master / plans-rules pollutes context without serving runtime enforcement.
